text.description_html:
Acorn PS8YP, Hand Painted Floral "X" Design Ceramic Cabinet Knob

A great way to add a pop of color to monochrome cabinets, the Floral "X" Design Ceramic Cabinet Knob by Acorn is available in either yellow and blue or yellow and teal. Both styles are hand painted on ceramic, making each one a little different, a little work or art. It measures 1-7/8" square. It is easy to install using one screw on any cabinet door or drawer.

Features of the Floral "X" Design Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" squared
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
